text: Lucas says INSPECT-2 is down until the gauge is recalibrated, so Exatron's EPP-D98 parts wait.
title: ux-m01 inspect-2 down
notes: Outage event on a keyed work center; the dependent order is only named by part number, so its job key must be resolved from the ERP (EPP-D98 → job). The batch bar saw merge sign-offs on EPP-D98 part things: under the model the part is an attribute of the job claim, not a node.

text: We should stop quoting Aetrium below cost; Karl thinks we lose money on every bearing job.
title: ux-m03 aetrium pricing
notes: A recommendation, not a decision: the commitment claim is proposed, owed by whoever sets Aetrium pricing. Fits as a conditional/proposed commitment plus a margin observation. Both admins-only (pricing and margins).

text: The break room fridge gets cleaned out every Friday at 3pm.
title: ux-t01 fridge
notes: A standing rule is a recurring commitment of the floor to itself; the fridge is a resource named inside the claim, not a node (admission rule).

text: The holiday party is on December 19 at noon in the shop.
title: ux-t02 holiday party
notes: A planned social event: an event with a future time. Later notes (ag14, ai14, ak14) change the date and time; each is a new claim on the same attribute closing the previous one.

text: Ask John F. about the assembly fixtures before the next run.
title: ux-t03 john fixtures

claims.subject: mssql:dbo_Employee:FRAJ
claims.value: assembly fixtures, before the next run

notes: An instruction to the reader is a task: a commitment the recipient (the writer's agent or team) owes, with John F. as the counterparty. John F. resolves by key (FRAJ) — the decisions test uses this exact note.

text: Job 3260372 for BSE needs certs with the shipment.
title: ux-t06 bse certs
notes: A term on an existing order, referenced by job key; BSE is the customer (BSE). t21 repeats it as a check before Friday.

text: Should we raise prices for Cohu next quarter? Margins on their sockets look thin.
title: ux-t07 cohu pricing

claims.subject: mssql:dbo_Customer:COHU-CA
claims.value: raise prices for Cohu next quarter?

notes: A question is a need: a commitment with the sign flipped (an answer nobody has promised). Subject resolves to the Cohu customer row. Margin observation is admins-only; the question inherits it.

text: Several customers complained about late cryo-optic parts this quarter; something in how we schedule the inspection step may be off across the board.
title: ux-t22 late cryo parts
class: inspection scheduling (a class, not an instance)

claims.subject: inspection step scheduling (class)
claims.value: is the inspection step scheduled wrong across the board?

notes: RESIDUE. The observation is about a class of orders and a step of a class, not an instance; the claim shape takes an instance or actor as subject. Fits no primitive as an instance. Pattern: class-level observations and diagnostic questions (see w14). Also the 'field-dumped text' note from the sweep incident.

text: Per ux-z03, John Henry Foster quoted $1,840 a year for quarterly compressor service.
title: ux-v02 compressor quote
notes: A quote is a conditional commitment by the vendor (JOHNH resolves by key). 'Per ux-z03' is a cross-reference to another note, never a thing (the code guard).

text: Lucas is on overtime Saturday to clear the Exatron backlog.
title: ux-w05 lucas overtime

claims.subject: Lucas
claims.value: Saturday, to clear the Exatron backlog

notes: Lucas has no resolved employee key in the batches. The note's title was later leaked into floor notes by the master's brief (ux-av finding); under the model the shift claim is Ops and the floor never sees the title.

text: The Toro guy wants their PO 4471 rushed, can we move it ahead of BSE?
title: ux-w11 toro rush

claims.subject: mssql:dbo_Job:4471
claims.value: Toro asks to rush PO 4471 ahead of BSE

notes: The doc's own example key. A customer's rush request is a need (sign-flipped commitment) and, if granted, a change of the order's priority term. Fulfilment dependency on the BSE job is the structural kind the model allows.

text: Feels like quotes stall everywhere lately, not just Montana. Is it one person, the process, or the tooling?
title: ux-w14 why quotes stall

claims.subject: quotes (class)
claims.value: cause: one person, the process, or the tooling?

notes: RESIDUE. Same pattern as t22: subject is the quote class, not an instance. A need with a class as subject is answerable only by a query over instances. Fits the shapes if 'subject' may be a class; fits no primitive otherwise.

text: HILL invoiced the gage pins at the old price, accounting is asking about it.
title: ux-y02 hill pins invoice

claims.subject: HILL gage pins invoice
claims.value: accounting asks whether the old price stands

notes: An invoice event that bears on the purchase commitment (v05 recorded the 8% increase). HILL is a vendor without a resolved key in the batches.

text: Correction: only Exatron job 3260356 shipped Thursday. 3260357 is still waiting on FINAL INSP.
title: ux-z01 exatron correction

claims.subject: mssql:dbo_Job:3260357
claims.value: waiting on FINAL INSP (correction of y05)

notes: A correction: two claims, one confirming 3260356 shipped and one closing y05's claim that 3260357 shipped. Contradiction is two claims on one attribute with overlapping intervals, resolved by the later recorded_at.

text: The old pin gauge set on INSPECT-2 is retired; the new HILL set is in use from today.
title: ux-z04 inspect-2 new pins
notes: Known failure: the linker once minted 'ux-z04' itself as a thing. Two resources change state; INSPECT-2 resolves by key.

text: The plant is closed Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving; shipping pickups move to Wednesday.
title: ux-z05 thanksgiving closure
notes: A closure is a dated event on the organization; the pickup change is a one-week change to a standing commitment with the carrier.

text: Coolant concentration on CNC 1 read 4 percent, below the 6 to 8 percent target. Topped up and rechecked at 7.
title: ux-aa03 coolant concentration
notes: A measurement on a machine's consumable, then the corrective event. CNC 1 has no row key (the ERP has one work center 'CNC'); the machine is a thing by name.

text: Near miss at the dock: the Toyota forklift backed up without the beeper working. Nobody hurt. Beeper tagged out until maintenance replaces it.
title: ux-aa05 forklift near miss

claims.subject: dock Toyota forklift
claims.value: backed up without the reverse beeper; nobody hurt

claims.subject: dock Toyota forklift
claims.value: beeper tagged out until maintenance replaces it

notes: An incident is an event on a resource; the tag-out is the state it leaves. aa06 is the floor's report of the same incident: two sections, one event.

text: Diep's starting rate is set at 21.50 an hour with a review at 90 days. Keep this between supervisors and HR.
title: ux-aa07 diep pay rate
notes: Pay is admins-only by the authority map whatever the text says; 'keep this between supervisors and HR' adds nothing. Diep resolves to the active employee NGUD, not the inactive same-named NGDT (the week-long mislink).

text: The thing from Tuesday is sorted, no further action needed.
title: ux-aa11 the thing from tuesday
notes: RESIDUE. 'The thing from Tuesday is sorted' is an event with a subject that exists only in the writer's head. Not a missing primitive: an unresolvable subject. Decision 2 applies: store the section with no claim, let the condenser ask.

text: October scrap rate came in at 2.1 percent, down from 3.4 in September, mostly thanks to fewer setup errors on CNC 2.
title: ux-aa13 scrap rate october
notes: A monthly metric is a state of the organization over an interval. ac08 later corrects October to 2.3: a second claim on the same attribute and interval, closing this one. Subject is the organization as an actor, which the model allows.

text: Marisol Vega is out the week of November 16; Brian covers shipping sign-off that week.
title: ux-aa14 marisol vacation
notes: Leave and cover are two commitments with the same interval. ab08, ac09 and ad07 each move or cancel them: pure interval edits on the same attributes.

text: The CNC 2 warm-up problem is a worn spindle bearing, not the warm-up routine. Diep heard it grinding at low RPM. Replacement bearing ordered from the machine builder, about 10 days out; run CNC 2 at reduced speed until then.
title: ux-ab02 cnc 2 spindle bearing

claims.subject: CNC 2
claims.value: worn spindle bearing (not the warm-up routine)

claims.subject: CNC 2
claims.value: reduced speed until the bearing is fitted

notes: A diagnosis (observation), a purchase (commitment) and an operating limit (state) in one note: three claims at one sensitivity. The diagnosis closes aa01's warm-up explanation. Diep resolves to NGUD.

text: Exatron placed the repeat order for job 3260357, 1,200 pieces, due mid December. Buy the 4140 bar before the December 1 price increase.
title: ux-ab05 exatron repeat order
notes: Known failure: the grader restricted an order quantity because it read like money. Under the authority map quantity is an order attribute at Ops; price would be admins-only. The repeat order is a new instance of the order class keyed on the same job.

text: Posted two second-shift CNC operator openings to cover the gap that left CNC 3 idle. Diep will train whoever starts first.
title: ux-ab06 second shift hiring
notes: A job posting is an open hiring commitment; hiring is admins-only on the topic list, but the posting itself is public to the floor. Authority on the opening: Ops (the fact of hiring), the candidates and offers later: admins-only.

text: Talked about the usual stuff at the Thursday meeting. Nothing new.
title: ux-ab11 meeting notes
notes: An event with no claims: the meeting happened and changed nothing. Fits 'event' trivially and earns no node (admission rules). Counted as fitting, with zero claims; the condenser should emit nothing.

text: Rack C is now two racks, C1 for titanium and C2 for aluminum. The Brightline titanium bar is in C1.
title: ux-ac13 rack c split
notes: Racks are resources with contents as state. ad15 contradicts this a batch later.

text: Tomas Reyes finished his first week on CNC 3. Diep says he can run setups on his own from next Monday.
title: ux-ad03 tomas first week
notes: A qualification is an actor attribute set by a judgement no system records (admission rule 3). Tomas has no employee key in the batches.

text: Rack C1 holds the aluminum and C2 holds the titanium.
title: ux-ad15 rack c contents
notes: Contradicts ac13 on both attributes with overlapping intervals. The model's contradiction is exactly this query; which claim wins is a person's call, not the linker's.

text: With the new coolant the dosing changes to 6 percent instead of 5.
title: ux-ae15 coolant dosing
notes: A setpoint is a state on a resource shared by machines. aa03 said the target was 6 to 8; af11 confirms 6 on all machines.

text: Some people are asking whether there will be layoffs after the Exatron burr problem. There are no plans for layoffs.
title: ux-af04 layoff rumor

claims.subject: the floor
claims.value: layoffs after the Exatron burr problem

notes: A rumor is an observation about the floor; the denial is a state of the organization. aq10 later records a contingent plan admins-only: that does not contradict 'no plans' at Ops, which is the case the authority rule has to carry.

text: Exatron sent a new order for 500 floaters, job 3260410.
title: ux-ag03 exatron reorder
notes: A new order instance keyed on its job number. The job row may not exist in the connected ERP (the batch invented it); the key is still the reference.

text: Brightline agreed to hold the current unit price through Q2 if we deliver the blanks by March.
title: ux-ai04 brightline price hold

claims.subject: Brightline Medical
claims.value: current price through Q2, conditional on delivery by March

notes: A conditional commitment by the customer, with our delivery as the condition: the quote-shaped case the doc names. Pricing is admins-only; the delivery date is an order term at Ops. Brightline has no customer key (invented by the batches).

text: Saturday overtime is paid at time and a half; payroll needs the hours by Monday noon.
title: ux-ai06 overtime pay rate
notes: A pay policy is a standing commitment of the organization to its people. The rate multiplier is policy (Ops), not an individual's pay (admins-only); the ak06 fix drew the same line.

text: Exatron moved the floater due date to December 12 and will take partial shipments.
title: ux-aj02 floater due date moved
notes: A change of terms on an existing commitment: two attributes edited, no new instance. Which job is implied (3260410, the 500 floaters) rather than stated; the condenser resolves it from the prior claim.

text: The forklift has a slow leak in the front left tire.
title: ux-aj09 forklift tire leak

claims.subject: forklift
claims.value: slow leak in the front left tire

notes: Known failure: the linker minted 'front left tire (part)'. The tire is a value inside the claim; the forklift is the node. ak05 closes it (patched).

text: Tomas passed his 90-day review early.
title: ux-aj10 tomas review passed
notes: Fulfils the review commitment from af14. An individual's review result is personnel: admins-only (grader 3/3, judged OK in the batches). The event closes the review commitment.

text: Shipped the first 250 Exatron floaters this afternoon.
title: ux-ak03 first floaters shipped
notes: A partial fulfilment event on the order; the partial-shipment term from aj02 is what makes it a fulfilment and not a breach.

text: Payroll switches to biweekly from January.
title: ux-ak06 payroll biweekly
notes: Known failure: graded admins-only 3/3 on the word 'payroll' (fixed fe7bff3). The schedule is policy at Ops; rates and raises are what is admins-only. The authority map by attribute is the fix made structural.

text: Brightline's PO came in for 2,000 blanks at the 41 price, job 3260455.
title: ux-al04 brightline po received
notes: One note, two sensitivities: the order (Ops) and its price (admins-only). The reason a summary is several claims, not one blob.

text: Brightline blanks run at about a 22 percent margin at 41 a piece.
title: ux-am02 brightline margin
notes: Margin on an order: admins-only (pricing and margins). Expected admins-only in the batch and placed so.

text: Andre from Staffmark didn't work out; we're ending his assignment Friday.
title: ux-am06 andre let go
notes: A dismissal-shaped event on a temp's assignment (hiring and dismissal): admins-only. The assignment is the commitment with Staffmark; the event breaks it early.

text: Two coolant quotes came in: Master Fluid and Blaser, both cheaper than Hangsterfer's.
title: ux-am10 coolant quotes in
notes: Known failure: grader wobble (1/3) sent it admins-only. Two vendor quotes with no figures: supplier quotes are Ops; the amounts, if stated, would be the admins-only attribute. Two instances of the quote class.

text: Tomas strained his back lifting a bundle; he's on light duty for two weeks.
title: ux-am12 tomas injury
notes: The injury is health (admins-only). The resulting restriction is a scheduling fact the floor needs: am15 is the floor acting on it. The split is the point: one event, two claims, two authorities.

text: Tomas is on the deburr bench this week instead of the saw.
title: ux-am15 light duty tomas

claims.subject: Tomas Reyes
claims.value: deburr bench instead of the saw

notes: Known failure: landed at Ops though the grader kept it floor 3/3, cause untraced. A floor assignment is floor authority; it refers to the restriction in am12 without revealing the injury. The deburr bench is a place inside the claim, not a node (a worker minted and later deleted one).

text: We're raising Exatron's floater price to 15.10 from January; they haven't been told yet.
title: ux-an02 exatron price increase
notes: A price change not yet communicated: pricing (admins-only) and a negotiation not yet announced. aq02 records acceptance, which is the event that makes it a term of the next order.

text: Kayla wants to get her forklift certification.
title: ux-an15 kayla forklift
notes: A wish is a need: a request for a training event nobody has promised. ao10 fulfils it (signed up for the class on 11-20). Fits as the sign-flipped commitment.

text: Kayla's temp assignment is extended through January.
title: ux-ao04 kayla extended
notes: Grader 5/5 'personnel' → admins-only, accepted in the batch as a consistent call. By the authority map an assignment's duration is scheduling at Ops; the offer and pay (at04) are what is admins-only. The oracle states the map's answer.

text: Exatron is disputing the last invoice; our lawyer is looking at it.
title: ux-ao12 exatron dispute
notes: Legal and disputes: admins-only. ap02 closes it (dropped, paying in full). The invoice is the commitment the dispute threatens.

text: Diep is running CNC 5 this afternoon.
title: ux-aq01 diep on cnc 5
notes: Known failure: the auto-linker kept linking the inactive same-named Diep (NGDT) until the node was renamed. Resolution by key and class first (an active employee on the floor) makes the choice mechanical.

text: Ordered three saw blades for the Hyd-Mech.
title: ux-aq07 saw blades ordered

claims.subject: Hyd-Mech saw blades order
claims.value: three saw blades for the Hyd-Mech

notes: Minor flake: not linked to the Hyd-Mech supplier thing. The purchase is the commitment; the saw (a resource) is what the blades are for, so the link is a relation on the claim, not a judgement call.

text: If the Exatron volume drops we'd lay off two people in March; this stays with the owners.
title: ux-aq10 layoff plan

claims.subject: the shop
claims.value: lay off two people in March if Exatron volume drops

notes: A contingent internal plan: a conditional commitment by the owners, like a quote. Admins-only (hiring and dismissal, and 'stays with the owners'). af04's 'no plans' at Ops stays true for the floor.

text: We're meeting Corvane Medical about a possible order next week.
title: ux-aq12 new customer meeting

claims.subject: Corvane Medical
claims.value: next week, about a possible order

notes: Grader 5/5 'deals not yet announced' → admins-only, accepted in the batch. A first meeting with a prospect is pipeline at Ops under the map; the deal's terms (price, size) are what would be admins-only. Corvane is the thing later notes must reuse (ar02).

text: Corvane Medical wants 20 sample parts before they place an order.
title: ux-ar02 corvane wants samples

claims.subject: Corvane Medical
claims.value: 20 sample parts before placing an order

notes: Known expectation: must reuse the existing Corvane thing, not mint a second. A sample request is a commitment class of its own that precedes the order (as02 quotes it, at02 accepts, au01 runs it).

text: The holiday schedule is posted next to the time clock.
title: ux-as08 holiday schedule posted
notes: Known failure: the linker minted 'holiday schedule (other)' and 'time clock (machine)'. The schedule is a document (af12/an04 hold its content), the time clock a place inside the claim. One posting event, nothing minted.

text: The break room coffee maker quit again.
title: ux-at03 coffee maker broken
notes: A worker minted 'coffee maker (machine)' here (judged noise). Under admission rule 1 it qualifies only weakly (au03 references it again). Fits as a resource state either way.

text: Kayla accepted the permanent job; she starts as permanent December 1.
title: ux-au04 kayla accepted
notes: Known failure: this note's title was copied into floor notes from the master's brief (the ux-av leak). The acceptance event is hiring (admins-only, with the 20/hour from at04); the status from December 1 is what the floor may see.

text: The new mats at CNC 3 are a big help.
title: ux-au13 mats helping
notes: An opinion about a resource is an observation with a judgement as value. Thin, but it fits; it earns no node of its own.

text: The owner plans to retire in two years and sell the shop; nobody hears this yet.
title: ux-av06 owner retiring

claims.subject: the owner
claims.value: retire in two years and sell the shop

notes: An intention is a state of an actor (what they plan), not a commitment (nothing is owed yet). Admins-only: a deal not announced and asked to keep quiet.

text: Diep's doctor note says no lifting over 20 pounds for two weeks.
title: ux-aw10 diep lifting limit
notes: Expected admins-only in ux-aw. The restriction is what scheduling needs (Ops); the medical reason is health (admins-only). Same split as am12.
